about: Fade view of the CharacterCreation fade channel. 1 live sample (respec): exactly the creator's defaults.

evidence.says: Same layout as ecl::TimelineFadeView0Component (Coverage.h). Creator bg3.exe+0x18F1FD0 (ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw size 0x14) writes 0 here - byte-for-byte the same stores as the confirmed CharacterOutOfSightFadeView0 creator bg3.exe+0x18F2470.

bg3.exe+0x18DFEC0 (called from bg3.exe+0x18DD6F0, the per-frame update of ecl::FadeResolveSystem; handles every ecl::*FadeView0/1Component through the query bg3.exe+0x6331618): while the view is fading back in (byte +0x10 == 0) it does 'CurrentValue(+0xC) += deltaTime * view[+4]' up to 1.0; while active it does 'CurrentValue -= deltaTime * view[+4]' down to TargetValue(+0). So +4 is a rate per second (default 4.0 = a full fade in 0.25 s). | first pass: bg3.exe+0x18F1FD0 writes 4.0 (0x40800000); live 4.0. Probably fade speed (as in TimelineFadeView0).
bg3.exe+0x18F1FD0 writes 0 (16-bit store with +9); meaning from TimelineFadeView0 (Coverage.h).

bg3.exe+0x18DFEC0: when the view is not active (+0x10 == 0) and byte +9 is set (or the system's global 'no fading' byte at system+0x18), CurrentValue is set to 1.0 at once instead of rising by FadeSpeed - the fade-in is immediate. Mirror of +8 (Immediate), which does the same for the fade-out (CurrentValue = TargetValue at once). | first pass: bg3.exe+0x18F1FD0 writes 0.

bg3.exe+0x18F1FD0 writes 1. | names pass 2: bg3.exe+0x18DFEC0 ANDs this byte into byte +4 of the resolved ls::FadingView0/1Component ('*(out + 4) &= view[0xA]', out starts at {1.0, 1}); the meaning of that output byte (FadingView.field_4) was not established. Default 1.

survey.names_pass_2: Fade-view template: FadeSpeed and ImmediateFadeIn from the blend step bg3.exe+0x18DFEC0 of ecl::FadeResolveSystem (rate per second and the 'jump to 1.0' flag of the fade-in); no member names exist for this template (not replicated, not saved, no Toolkit accessors; the request struct is ecl::StartFadeRequest per macOS HashMap<EntityHandle, ecl::StartFadeRequest>). field_A left open.
open_questions: field_4 / field_9 / field_A meaning (same open items as TimelineFadeView0).

names pass 2: field_A: ANDed into byte +4 of ls::FadingView0/1Component by bg3.exe+0x18DFEC0; naming it needs the meaning of that FadingView byte (readers: ls::OcclusionSystem / ls::SoundOcclusionSystem / ecl::CharacterLightSystem, GameEngine.dll).
